status: Reviewed by project owner 2026-10-26. All 14 kept; third free-form option added.
note: Contested topics for the belief profile. Every item is optional. Beyond the two common positions, a user may answer in their own words by voice or text; that answer is simplified and shown back for approval before it is ever used (agents/beliefs.py).

topics.question: How do you read Scripture?
topics.position_a: Plainly and literally, as directly authoritative
topics.position_b: Through historical and literary context, with interpretation

topics.question: Who should be baptized?
topics.position_a: Infants, as members of the covenant community
topics.position_b: Those old enough to profess faith for themselves

topics.question: What happens in Communion?
topics.position_a: Christ is truly present in the bread and wine
topics.position_b: It is a symbol and memorial

topics.question: Who may lead and teach in church?
topics.position_a: Teaching and pastoral office is for men
topics.position_b: Women and men alike may hold any office

topics.question: What is your church's teaching on marriage and sexuality?
topics.position_a: Marriage is between one man and one woman
topics.position_b: Same-sex relationships can be blessed and affirmed

topics.question: How do you understand divorce and remarriage?
Where do you land on alcohol?
How is a person saved?
topics.position_b: By grace through faith expressed in works and sacraments

topics.question: Can salvation be lost?
topics.position_a: No, the saved are eternally secure

topics.question: Are the miraculous spiritual gifts active today?
topics.position_a: Yes, tongues, prophecy and healing continue
topics.position_b: No, those gifts ceased with the apostolic age

topics.question: How do God's sovereignty and human choice fit together?
topics.position_a: God elects; salvation rests on his choosing
topics.position_b: People freely respond to grace offered to all

topics.question: Should the church speak on politics?
topics.position_a: The church should speak directly to political questions
topics.position_b: The church should stay out of partisan matters

topics.question: Where do you land on contraception?
topics.position_a: It is contrary to the purpose of marriage
topics.position_b: It is a matter of conscience

own_words_option.label: Let me say it in my own words
own_words_option.flow: transcribe -> simplify -> show back -> user approves -> store
own_words_option.rule: An unapproved paraphrase is never used to condition counsel.
